title: Mockified Textures
description: A small texture pack that changes a couple things for easy of use, or to make them more consistant
body:
Hey, this is a texture pack project I have been working on for a bit on and off. Its main focus is to retexture or add textures to increase conistancy, or update textures to be more in the semi-modern mojang style. Due to this 90% of textures will not be changed :>.

Each version of the texture pack is slightly different as its based on what that version of the game has/needs. For example the 1.20.1 pack has confirmed and tested modded support, while the 2 most modern versions, technically have it, but its untested. 

Below here are some of the changes that I like the most or best represent the pack <3:

![A comparison between vanilla and the retexture of the brewing stand item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db6c6816c2e453da8f14479fad06287c6c2e802e.png)![Visually distinct powders, mostly for those with color issues, or logic issues (like myself)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34059de78fd8b9ec520ee01d86d1826cbad1db4d.png)![Creeper retexture to be a mix of the traditional creeper, and more modern versions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/13f87dd2e6c3c905e18b79d1a48700fc6be6164f_0.webp)![A bunch of miscellaneous textures in the pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28ce8d6dee1b3c2cf309bd1400443d4df78fa83a.png)

Mod Compatibility List:
- Appleskin (1.20.1 & 1.21.4)
- Overflowing Bars (1.20.1 & 1.21.4)
- Farmer's Delight Decapricated (1.20.1)
- Supplementaries (1.20.1)

Final note on usage: Go nuts, modify, improve, and whatnot I made this to be used, if you dont like something, change it. I am only really releasing this for convenience anyway, and maybe to get my name out a little bit. Would love if yall just put me somewhere in the description if you release it somewhere else, but ya dont have to <3
